summary: V4-04 implementation fully satisfies all acceptance criteria. The Add tab exposes Task|Expense switch, user-created categories with default ratio snapshotting, equal/category/custom task splits with override precedence, exact integer-minor-unit expense splits (equal/custom), optional notes and photos on both entry types, a Members section replacing the old activity history, and native share sheet integration. All V3 invariants (zero-sum ledgers, local-first, delta sync, privacy separation) are preserved. No regressions in V4-01 through V4-03. Trusted verification passed with 588 tests, privacy gate, cost gates, and i18n checks all green.
